answer: I would anchor trust in Home insurance policy tenure with insurer attestation. With a policy renewed every year for a decade, a single ledge check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the vault of that gap is the whole defence in one line. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the delta of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
